entities.name: Acun Ilıcalı
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ali Acun Ilıcalı is a Turkish broadcaster, entrepreneur, international TV producer, and businessman. He is the owner of the TV channels TV8 and TV8.5, Turkey's digital platform Exxen. He is the founder and director of ACUNMEDYA, an international television production company.
